commands.label: Show Git changes
commands.description: Shows the changed files and the commit message box.
examples: SPC g g → the changed files and the commit message box appear
commands.rationale: Doom Emacs (Magit) and LazyVim (lazygit) use SPC g g to open the Git status.

vscode.note: Focus moves to the commit message box, or to the list of changes when a file there is already selected. In the box, Escape erases the message instead of returning to the editor; Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS) restores it. Ctrl+Shift+G (also on macOS) returns to the editor.
